subject: general
question: What would come in (3)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4** i.e. **equality**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage emphasizes that true freedom must coexist with responsibilities and consideration for others.
 
• The blank (3) refers to what freedom should preserve for everyone—fairness and equal treatment.
 
• **Equality** (समानता) fits best as it conveys fairness and justice for all members of society.
 
• Other options like **justice convenience**, **convenience**, or **access** do not fully capture the moral and civic balance implied in the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4** i.e. **equality**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Justice convenience** (न्याय सुविधा): Grammatically incorrect and confusing; does not fit the context.
 
• **Convenience** (सुविधा): Refers to ease or comfort, irrelevant to fairness or moral balance.
 
• **Access** (पहुँच): Refers to availability or opportunity, which does not convey the moral principle implied.
